body:
This branch renames the Cloudy `ParticleDistributions`. The reason is that the term `Mixture`, as it has been used so far, is potentially confusing since a Cloudy `Mixture` differs conceptually from mixture distributions as they are defined in probability and statistics. `Mixtures` have been renamed to `AdditiveParticleDistributions`, a term that more accurately describes what these objects are. The other `ParticleDistribution` types have been renamed as well, according to the following table:

| **Old Name**                | **New Name**                                        |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| ParticleDistribution        | AbstractParticleDistribution                    |
| Primitive                        | PrimitiveParticleDistribution                    |
| Exponential                   | ExponentialPrimitiveParticleDistribution |
| Gamma                         | GammaPrimitiveParticleDistribution       |
| Mixture                          | AdditiveParticleDistribution                     |
| ExponentialMixture       | ExponentialAdditiveParticleDistribution  |
| GammaMixture             | GammaAdditiveParticleDistribution        |

The new names are more expressive and interpretable but rather long. Happy to make adjustments if anyone has an idea on how to shorten the names without loss of "descriptive power."

The branch also removes some old dependencies (`HomotopyContinuation`, `DynamicPolynomials`) that are not used.
title: Rename ParticleDistributions
